notes.title: Shutting down Truncheon Titties
notes.content:
[p]Hi everyone - thanks to all who purchased and enjoyed the game. 

I am going to remove the game from sale/steam and it will be retired permanently. 

I made the game during intense grief over my Brother's overdose and suicide and I am no longer comfortable with the content in the game. I feel it was a phase of grief that kept me focused on the task but is now not helpful or serving anyone in a healthy way.

There are some good points to the game and I did grow a lot through the effort. 

Again thanks to everyone who supported the game, especially in it's initial launch.[/p]
